original_title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Has Already Earned the Series' Biggest Player Peak on Steam

en.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Sets New Steam Record for Franchise
en.summary: The highly anticipated remake of Assassin's Creed Black Flag has sailed past all previous franchise entries on Steam, achieving a massive player peak. This success marks a significant win for Ubisoft and its beloved pirate adventure.
en.body:
The high seas have never been so crowded on PC. **Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced** has officially become the most played game in the franchise on Steam, shattering previous records with an impressive launch peak of 99,451 concurrent players. This remarkable surge in player numbers, achieved just a day after its release on July 9, 2026, signifies a triumphant return for Edward Kenway's swashbuckling saga and a much-needed boost for publisher **Ubisoft**.

The remake's performance dwarfs that of more recent entries, with **Assassin's Creed Shadows** reaching a peak of 64,825 players and **Assassin's Creed Odyssey** garnering 62,069. While not all Assassin's Creed titles have launched simultaneously on Steam – **Assassin's Creed Valhalla**, for instance, arrived later – the sheer scale of **Black Flag Resynced**'s early success is undeniable. This accomplishment is particularly noteworthy given **Ubisoft**'s recent challenges, including layoffs and development delays, proving that a well-loved classic, given a modern touch, can still capture the gaming public's imagination.

## A Storm of Player Engagement

The anticipation for **Black Flag Resynced** was palpable, with pre-order figures on PC reportedly 5.39 times higher than those for **Assassin's Creed Shadows**. This strong pre-launch interest has clearly translated into massive player engagement post-release. The remake isn't just a graphical update; IGN's review lauded it as a game that "brings what was already one of the best games in the series up to today’s standards," awarding it a strong 9/10. The game's success also means it has already surpassed the lifetime sales of **Skull & Bones**, **Ubisoft**'s ambitious pirate spinoff that struggled to find its sea legs.

## The Pirate King's Reign on Steam

For fans, this isn't just about numbers; it's a powerful statement about the enduring legacy of **Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag**. Many consider the original game a high point for the series, praised for its open-world freedom, compelling pirate narrative, and innovative naval combat. The success of **Resynced** suggests a strong desire from the community to revisit these elements with updated visuals and gameplay mechanics. It’s a clear indication that while the franchise has explored various historical settings, the golden age of piracy still holds a special place in players' hearts, proving that the call of the open ocean and treasure hunting remains as strong as ever.

## Charting the Course Ahead

With such a monumental launch, all eyes will be on **Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced** to see if it can maintain this momentum. Further updates and potential post-launch content are yet to be detailed by **Ubisoft**, but the current player numbers provide a powerful foundation for the game's future on PC and likely other platforms.

content_raw: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is off to a strong start on Steam, with around 100,000 concurrent players — more than any other title in the franchise to date. Ubisoft's ground-up remake of its beloved pirate adventure game currently has launch peak of 99,451 players at the time of writing, making it comfortably the series' best ever launch on Steam. By comparison, 2025's feudal Japan-set Assassin's Creed Shadows recorded a launch peak of 64,825 players, while the Ancient Greek-set Assassin's Creed Odyssey earned 62,069. Not all Assassin's Creed games have appeared on Steam at launch (the hugely-popular Viking entry Valhalla turned up later), so comparisons aren't entirely straightforward. Still, no other Assassin's Creed game comes close to matching Black Flag's early haul, which will likely prove a relief for publisher Ubisoft after a turbulent few years of layoffs, delays, and underwhelming sales. Black Flag Resynced had been expected to perform well on Steam, after a report this week suggested pre-orders on the PC platform were 5.39 times higher than those for Shadows. Impressively, this also means that Resynced has already beaten the lifetime sales of Skull & Bones , Ubisoft's costly, long-in-development pirate spinoff from Black Flag that eventually emerged in 2024. "More than just a shinier version of the same game you remember, Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced brings what was already one of the best games in the series up to today’s standards," IGN wrote in our Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced review , dredging up a fine 9/10 score.
